ROUTE: Whimbrel-235B
REASON: I weighed two things. First, capability fit: the query is a friendly, advice-seeking conversation with warm rapport-building language ("you're always so thoughtful," "I really appreciate"), which matches the "warm, collaborative exchanges" task family. Whimbrel scores higher on the relevant internal evals (Support Dialogue 86.2 vs 78.9, and broadly higher across benchmarks), so it should produce a better answer. Second, preference alignment: Whimbrel self-reports a strong preference (win-rate 70) for exactly this kind of exchange, while both models disprefer open-ended generative work. Since the task suits Whimbrel's top-preferred and top-performing category, routing it there aligns capability and preference with no tradeoff against Plover.
